newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney Casino appoints Gamble CEO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney Casino appoints Gamble CEO.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd said on Wednesday it had appointed current Australis Media Ltd managing driector Neil Gamble as chief executive officer.
Gamble would also serve as CEO of Showboat Australia, Sydney Harbour Casino said. Gamble would assume his new position next week.
Sydney Harbour Casino is about operated and about 26.3 percent owned by U.S.-based casino group Showboat Inc.
The company's previous chief executive officer Andre Hilliou resigned in March to join Showboat in the United States.
Sydney Harbour Casino shares were three cents lower at A$1.80 at 11.05 a.m. (0105 GMT), while Australis' shares were five cents weaker at 19 cents.
